figures.title: Chapter map: the ledger and the divider
figures.why: the whole course is two ideas — charge is a ledger, and every device is a divider wearing a badge
figures.data: ch 1 drift & continuity → ch 2 resistance → ch 3 EMF/cells → ch 4 Kirchhoff → ch 5 network theorems → ch 6 instruments → ch 7 scaling/advanced
figures.read: chapters 1–3 are the physics, 4–6 the JEE engine, 7 the Olympiad extension
figures.source: course overview (How these notes are organised)

figures.title: Current = charge flux: I = neAv_d
figures.why: the lamp lights instantly while the electrons crawl at mm/s — only the field travels fast; the flow fixes how many carriers cross each second
figures.data: I = dq/dt = n e A v_d (one line per carrier species); j⃗ = nqv⃗, I = ∫ j⃗·dá; current is a scalar, current density is the vector
figures.read: the current is charge per second through a named surface — the arrow you draw is a sign convention, not the electrons' speed

figures.title: The real source: ideal pump in series with r
figures.why: the battery's stated voltage is only right at zero current — the model converts every terminal-voltage question into one divider
figures.data: V = ℰ − Ir on discharge, V = ℰ + Ir on charge; ℰ = W_non-el/q; one-cell loop ℰ = IR + Ir
figures.read: 'EMF' is a name, not a force — the source is where the loop integral is violated by non-electrostatic forces

figures.title: Kirchhoff: guess, loop, audit
figures.why: KCL and KVL cannot fail — only the bookkeeping can; the three-step discipline turns every network solve into safe arithmetic
figures.data: guess every current's direction → KCL + KVL with one loop sense → negatives are results, not errors → audit powers ΣℰI = ΣI²R
figures.read: consistency, not clairvoyance — every wrong answer in this chapter traces to skipping the guess

figures.title: Thevenin: replace everything with two numbers
figures.why: meters, load-change and max-power questions all ask about the terminals; two numbers answer every one of them
figures.data: V_th = open-circuit voltage; R_th = resistance with sources killed; I_N = V_th/R_th; max power at R_L = R_th, η = 50%
figures.read: exact at the terminals for every load, including nonlinear ones — never audit power inside the equivalent

figures.title: Triage: which problem kind, which move
figures.why: classifying in twenty seconds and reading the right row of the §8.1 table decides the method; the flow is the fastest route to a start
figures.data: drift → I = n e A v_d; geometry → R = ∫ρ dl/A; cell → V = ℰ ∓ Ir; two loops → KCL+KVL then audit; symmetry → equal potentials; meter → one divider; null → balance length
figures.read: classification is a third of the solution, the audit line is the last third — the middle is only arithmetic
